headline: Tech giants sue California over child social media law
summary: Google, Meta and TikTok sued California to block Assembly Bill 1709, a law meant to protect children from social media addiction by banning features like autoplay that encourage compulsive use and requiring removal of "psychologically exploitative features," restricting access for children under 16 if it takes effect next year.

claims.statement: Google, Meta, and TikTok sued California to block a new law intended to protect children from social media addiction.

sources.quote: Google, Meta and TikTok are all suing California to block social media law intended to help kids
